title: A true life changer
body:
It really works as advertised. I couldn’t imagine how addicted I would get to tapping green boxes, but it’s been a great help in changing my habits.

Thanks to this app I stopped watching YouTube, no more toilet on the phone, sending texts regularly to my grandmother, practice a new language and read way more books than ever before.

It’s fantastic details like “skip today” and leave blank completely to make it realistic.

Like doing a workout 3 days a week, I skip 4, without losing my streak.

author: missnenni

title: Great app!
body: I like the app a lot! It’s easy to use and understand. I would like to be able to track more habits on the free version, but I understand why it’s limited. I use this every day and I actually think three habits is enough.  If you want to track more habits and are ambitious enough to follow through with updating and changing them I think it’s worth it to spend some money on it. (Especially now, since it’s cheaper because of the coronavirus) I really like that you can take notes on each day and the fact that notes you took earlier will be saved and you can click on them to use the Sam notes later. However, I wish there was a way to see everything written underneath too, because if I start with the same words I can’t tell the difference. A preview on the full sentences would be nice! I’ve seen that some users had trouble getting into the app, but I personally haven’t had any issues and I think it’s worth to try downloading the app to see if it works for you too, because I think it can be very helpful if you update and stick to the routines you decide to keep.
